text: At Kashihara, below a green mountain, Iwarebiko built a palace whose pillars, the chronicle says, were driven into the bedrock.
spoken: At Kahsheehahrah, below a green mountain, Eewahrehbeeko built a palace whose pillars, the chronicle says, were driven into the bedrock.

pauzy.regula: przecinek, po nazwie, długie słowo (4 syl.)

pauzy.uwaga: brak pauzy w nagraniu — zostaje bez pauzy
brak pauzy w nagraniu — zostaje bez pauzy
